# Hook State Checklist: State writes from the hook only

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for the four hook writes (core runtime) before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Signal completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a signal named for each of the four writes (risk, feature folder, phase done, label clear)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the exact marker text fixed for each reply marker, with its line-start rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it defined which state file each write targets (main checkout or working-folder file)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it defined whether `Phase: done` applies in any phase, or only in `close` and `fast`? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Turn scope and timing

- [ ] CHK005 Is "current turn" defined so a reader can tell a real prompt from a tool result or injected skill text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the latest point by which `risk` must be written named, with the in-turn reader it must precede? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the late-transcript case covered, with the measured delay as its source? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, research §R1]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it defined what happens when a turn has two `Lane:` lines with different levels? [Gap]

## Regression and scope

- [ ] CHK009 Does each acceptance scenario have a negative control that leaves the value unchanged? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Scenario 8]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "same values at each step as today" checkable step by step? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all callers of the deleted script listed, with what replaces each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the accepted limits (the `{}` start line, interactive mode not measured, no live check in this session) stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the failure behavior defined: a missing or broken state file, a hook error? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
